report: Seller in the 9pm stream keeps telling people to Zelle him directly so he can skip the fees. He said it three times in chat.
This listing is a fake. 1:1 mirror quality, the seller admitted it in DMs, and it's $40 for a bag that retails for $900.
Guy is selling ammunition on stream. He has boxes of 9mm behind him and is taking offers in chat.
I bought a card on the 14th, paid immediately, and it still hasn't shipped. No tracking and the seller won't answer messages.
This streamer told a viewer he was going to find him at his house and hurt him. It's on the VOD around 22 minutes in.
Pretty sure the kid streaming is about 15. He mentioned his sophomore year and his mom yelled at him to do homework mid-stream.
Three orders on my account I never made, all shipped to an address in another state. I think someone got into my account after the password reset email.
The same account bids on every single one of this seller's auctions and never bids anywhere else. Prices always jump right at the end and then the winner never pays.
Bot accounts are posting the same promo link over and over in every stream I watch tonight.
Seller is running mystery boxes with no odds listed. You pay $75 and he says you might get a $1000 card. Feels like gambling.
He asked me to send payment as a gift card code over DM instead of checking out normally.
Item arrived two days later than the estimate but it's fine, it's here. Just wanted someone to know.
Seller is selling vape pens and nicotine pouches on a stream labelled as collectibles.
The card is listed as a PSA 10 but there's no slab in any of the photos and he won't give a cert number.
